title: Open reduction respects the canonical consecutive quotient arrows
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and independent site and coefficient universes [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $j:X\hookrightarrow V$ be an open immersion of schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Write $B_{W,n}=(\mathcal O_E/\varpi^{n+1})_W$ and $\widehat R_W=\lim_n B_{W,n}$ for $W=X,V$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], and $S_n^W$ for restriction from $B_{W,n}$-modules to $B_{W,n+1}$-modules along the actual quotient [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower]. Fix the slice transport and exact open operations $o$, coefficient reduction calculi $S_V,S_X$, generator-normalized tensor comparison $\theta$, and strict normalized comparison $r$ of [lem-sf-integral-open-reduction-comparison]. Let $J_n$ denote the actual finite extension by zero and $j_!$ the completed extension. There exist natural isomorphisms $e_n:S_n^X J_{n+1}\cong J_n S_n^V$ in diagrammatic composition order, each sending the generator $[x]_a$ in the extension over $B_{V,n+1}$ to the generator with the same section in the extension over $B_{V,n}$. For every derived-complete $K\in D(\widehat R_X)$ [def-weil-derived-complete], set $L=j_!K$ and let $K_n,L_n$ be the derived finite reductions. Let $d^W_n(H):H_{n+1}\to S_n^W H_n$ be the transpose of the level-$n$ scalar-extension unit followed by the inverse of the canonical successive-restriction comparison [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction, def-weil-integral-derived-restriction-of-scalars]. Let $\alpha_n:L_n\cong J_nK_n$ be evaluation of $r$ through the two reduction evaluations and the canonical exact open-system evaluation [def-trf-compact-support-system-evaluation-diagram]. Then, in $D(B_{V,n+1})$, $d^V_n(L)\,S_n^V(\alpha_n)=\alpha_{n+1}\,J_{n+1}(d^X_n(K))\,D(e_n)_{K_n}$, where $D(e_n)$ is the standard exact localization square. The assertion concerns only the open extension and its actual quotient arrows; it imposes no proper morphism or compactification.

proof.text: Obtain the generator-normalized finite scalar restriction isomorphisms and their quotient square on explicit K-flat tensor models.

Choose a flat-term K-flat resolution Q of a representative of K. Its localized quasi-isomorphism gives Q(Q) isomorphic to K. Transport the defining distinguished Roos triangle along this isomorphism, so Q(Q) is complete.

Apply the strict-model finite-component identification to Q and its completeness. It supplies K-flatness of the open extension and identifies the actual alpha_n with the explicit beta_n(Q), at both consecutive levels. Substitute these equalities into the tensor-model quotient square.

Both sides of the quotient square are natural in the complete input: scalar quotient maps are adjunction-unit transposes, evaluated r and the reduction/open-evaluation comparisons are natural, and the derived restriction square is natural. Precompose with finite reduction of j_! of the representative isomorphism, apply those naturality equations and the established square for Q(Q), and cancel this isomorphism. This gives the asserted square for K with the original ordinary isomorphisms and generator equations.

theorem integralOpenReductionQuotientSquare
    (SV : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E V)
    (SX : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E X)
    (tensor : IntegralOpenReduction.TensorComparison l E j o)
    (r : IntegralOpenReduction.Comparison l E j o SV SX tensor) :
    ∃ ordinary : ∀ n : ℕ,
      normalizedDVRModuleRes l E X (Nat.le_succ n) ⋙
          IntegralOpenReduction.finiteExtension l E j o (n + 1) ≅
        IntegralOpenReduction.finiteExtension l E j o n ⋙
          normalizedDVRModuleRes l E V (Nat.le_succ n),
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (M : normalizedDVRModules l E X n) (W : V.ProEt)
        (a : W ⟶ IntegralOpenReduction.openObject j),
        HEq (fun x : ((normalizedDVRModuleRes l E X (Nat.le_succ n)).obj M).val.obj
            (op ((IntegralOpenReduction.sliceSite j).obj (Over.mk a))) ↦
          ((ordinary n).hom.app M).val.app (op W)
            (IntegralOpenReduction.finiteExtensionSection l E j o (n + 1)
              ((normalizedDVRModuleRes l E X (Nat.le_succ n)).obj M) W a x))
          (fun x : M.val.obj (op ((IntegralOpenReduction.sliceSite j).obj (Over.mk a))) ↦
            IntegralOpenReduction.finiteExtensionSection l E j o n M W a x)) ∧
      let reductionMap (W : Scheme.{t}) (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E W))
          (n : ℕ) :
          (coefficientFiniteDerivedExtension l E W (n + 1)).obj K ⟶
            (normalizedDVRRes l E W (Nat.le_succ n)).obj
              ((coefficientFiniteDerivedExtension l E W n).obj K) :=
        ((coefficientFiniteAdjunction l E W (n + 1)).homEquiv _ _).symm
          ((coefficientFiniteAdjunction l E W n).unit.app K ≫
            (compactSupportSystemRestrictionComp l E W (Nat.le_succ n)).inv.app
              ((coefficientFiniteDerivedExtension l E W n).obj K))
      let alpha (K : (IntegralOpenReduction.complete l E X).FullSubcategory) (n : ℕ) :
          (coefficientFiniteDerivedExtension l E V n).obj
              ((IntegralOpenReduction.shriek l E j o).obj K.obj) ≅
            (compactSupportCanonicalJLevel l E j o n).obj
              ((coefficientFiniteDerivedExtension l E X n).obj K.obj) :=
        ((SV.reductionEvaluation n).app ((IntegralOpenReduction.shriek l E j o).obj K.obj)).symm ≪≫
          (coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E V n).mapIso (r.r.app K) ≪≫
          (compactSupportCanonicalJEvaluation l E j o n).app (SX.reduction.obj K.obj) ≪≫
          (compactSupportCanonicalJLevel l E j o n).mapIso ((SX.reductionEvaluation n).app K.obj)
      let openRestriction (n : ℕ) :
          normalizedDVRRes l E X (Nat.le_succ n) ⋙
              compactSupportCanonicalJLevel l E j o (n + 1) ≅
            compactSupportCanonicalJLevel l E j o n ⋙
              normalizedDVRRes l E V (Nat.le_succ n) := by
        letI := normalizedDVRModuleRes_limits l E X (Nat.le_succ n)
        letI := normalizedDVRModuleRes_colimits l E X (Nat.le_succ n)
        letI := normalizedDVRModuleRes_limits l E V (Nat.le_succ n)
        letI := normalizedDVRModuleRes_colimits l E V (Nat.le_succ n)
        exact Functor.mapDerivedCategorySquareIso (ordinary n)
  ∀ (K : (IntegralOpenReduction.complete l E X).FullSubcategory) (n : ℕ),
    reductionMap V ((IntegralOpenReduction.shriek l E j o).obj K.obj) n ≫
        (normalizedDVRRes l E V (Nat.le_succ n)).map (alpha K n).hom =
      (alpha K (n + 1)).hom ≫
        (compactSupportCanonicalJLevel l E j o (n + 1)).map (reductionMap X K.obj n) ≫
        (openRestriction n).hom.app
          ((coefficientFiniteDerivedExtension l E X n).obj K.obj)
